findings.summary: Capability-wide checks not run in this unit: `pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/brand.spec.ts` (spec does not exist yet / owned by integration) and the Play dev-link walkthrough (save PNG and JPG logos, export the three PDFs). They depend on sibling backend units and integration.

eslint is not installed in the project (`pnpm exec eslint` -> command not found); lint was not run. `aioson rules:check` over the 4 changed files reported 0 violations (size, coupling, English identifiers, no native dialogs).

Name limit follows AC-ra-20 (80 characters), not the prototype (60). The picked logo stays pending (thumbnail + size hint) until 'Salvar marca', as in the prototype: Save sends PUT /api/brand then PUT /api/brand/logo; a refused logo keeps the saved fields and shows the server message in the logo field. 'Remover logo' on a never-saved pending logo just drops it without a dialog (nothing stored is lost); with a saved logo it uses ConfirmDialog.

evidence.summary: IF-003 only: BrandSection imports getBrand/saveBrand/saveBrandLogo/removeBrandLogo/resetBrand/brandLogoUrl from src/api/brandApi.ts and isApiError; no other API module. Cover preview is built client-side from the saved Brand and drawn by ReportSheet (same CoverBlock as the report preview).

AC-ra-20: name (maxLength 80, label by usage mode: 'Nome que aparece no relatório' in owner mode, 'Nome de quem entrega' in consultant mode), PhoneField (inputmode=tel, mask via shared maskPhoneInput, blur error 'Telefone inválido. Use (11) 91234-5678.'), e-mail/site with getEmailError/getWebsiteError on blur and aria-invalid via TextField; 'Salvar marca' (data-aioson-id=brand-save) updates the cover preview from the server answer. AC-ra-21: brandLogoImage checks size <= 2 MB and PNG/JPEG magic bytes before decoding, shrinks to 600 px on the longer side in the same format, refuses with 'Use uma imagem PNG ou JPG de até 2 MB.' leaving everything unchanged; 'Remover logo' and 'Voltar para a marca FitPulse' go through ConfirmDialog (AC-ra-59).

messages.text: Run `pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/brand.spec.ts` and the Play dev-link check once the backend brand units are merged. Selectors available: section data-aioson-id=brand-section; form brand-form; inputs #brand-name, #brand-phone, #brand-email, #brand-website, file input #brand-logo-file (label data-aioson-id=brand-logo-upload); buttons brand-save, brand-logo-remove, brand-reset; dialogs brand-logo-remove-confirm ('Remover logo') and brand-reset-confirm ('Apagar a marca'); status line brand-status ('Marca salva. Os próximos PDFs saem com ela.'); logo error #brand-logo-error (role=alert); preview data-aioson-id=brand-cover-preview containing a report-sheet.

The cover preview mirrors server/report/documentParts.ts (resolveBrand: blank name -> 'FitPulse'; contact line 'phone · email · site'; credit 'Preparado por X com o FitPulse em DD/MM/AAAA' / 'Gerado com o FitPulse em ...') without importing server code, and uses brandLogoUrl(logoUpdatedAt) as the src. If the server copy changes, update previewCoverPage in BrandSection.tsx or move the shared copy to shared/.
GET /api/brand/logo must be readable by a plain (no Bearer header) for the thumbnail and the preview; brandApi.ts comments say so, confirm in the e2e.
